title: Chapter 460
text:
Han Xiao naturally did not know that the people of Dark-star were tracking the traitor in Noriose and had bought a piece of intel from the intelligence organization.

Coincidentally, he had brushed past Ashes, and neither of them had noticed the other.

At this time, the trader brought them to a cubicle, and they all sat down.

"What kind of intel do you want to buy? Our organization has a very strong intelligence network. Be it current affairs or secret information, we have it all," the trader boasted.

"I want to find someone. Give me a pen and paper, and I'll draw his face."

The higher the Intelligence attribute, the clearer the memory. Han Xiao quickly drew a portrait of a human on the paper. According to the lifespan of a normal human, this person looked to be around fifty years old. He had a full beard, a chiseled face, and many wrinkles. From the outside, he looked like an ordinary middle-aged man who had been through a lot.

"This person should have been to Noriose before. I want to know when and where he appeared," Han Xiao said.

The trader nodded, took out an internal device, and searched for a while before saying, "We have the right information. This is an ordinary person. Our spies have recorded all the travelers who came to Noriose. Recently, we've been holding a discount to find people. This intel only costs 100 Enas."

Sylvia was speechless. Intel was indeed expensive. Just finding someone marked as an ordinary person cost 100 Enas, which was enough to travel a few Star Systems on a galactic travel group. She had also spent a lot of money to buy information on Han Xiao's whereabouts in the past.

If she had been cowardly back then and not taken revenge, she would not have known the truth about her father and would have lived in a false hatred. How sad would her life have been? She would not have become her teacher's disciple and would never have been able to come into contact with the Super domain. Thinking back, she could not help but feel grateful that Han Xiao did not kill her. Otherwise, she would not be where she was today.

For a moment, Sylvia was filled with emotions.

After Han Xiao made the payment, the trader passed the information over, and everyone gathered around to take a look.

"This person came to Noriosse 38 days ago. He took a cross-Star Field flight from the [Ancient Star Desert] Star Field. He didn't do anything special in Noriosse. It seems like he's just here for a trip. The last time he appeared was 16 days ago, south of City 8 …"

A detailed address was written on it. This was the last place the target was seen.

"Sixteen days ago? Is he still in Noriose? "Han Xiao asked.

The trader nodded. "We have internal personnel at the port. Every registered ID has a record. He hasn't left Noriose, so he should still be in that place."

"That's not necessarily the case …" Han Xiao was noncommittal.

Intelligence agencies were not omnipotent. As long as one changed their appearance and used a fake identity ID, it would be easy to fool the eyes of the spies. He could do it easily.

Furthermore, the Dragon Emperor's teacher was a Prophet!

After experiencing the effects of the Destiny's Child Character Summon Card so many times, he understood the ability of prophecies. Prophecies were not omniscient, and the future they saw would not be too far away from the present. If the target did not use prophecies, he would be no different from an ordinary person. Perhaps the target did not know that they were looking for him … but that would be a dream. The target should have known long ago!

Prophets were all very difficult to deal with. If they did not want to be found, it was too easy for them to hide with their abilities.

Just like how the Germinal Organization could not find him back then.

Han Xiao could not tell what the target was thinking. If the target wanted to see Ames, he would not have hidden at all. Although he had the Destiny's Child Character Summon Card, he did not intend to use it here because the result would not affect him much.

The important thing was to carry out the 'search'. The result was not important. Anyway, as long as he could give Ames some clues, he would have completed his mission.

As for whether Ames could see her teacher or not, Han Xiao did not care.

After getting the clues he wanted, he led everyone out of the intelligence organization and went straight to the station. They boarded the high-speed maglev train to City 8.

There were many carriages on the train. The carriage they were in was a group seat with the seats around a table.

The scenery outside the window flew by. Herlous was playing cards with the three brothers again. Fu Ding was watching how normal people played cards. Aroshia was eating snacks, and Sylvia was playing with Philip, who was spinning in circles.

Because they were only in Noriose to look for someone, everyone was very relaxed. Black Star was the best at finding things anyway. With him around, there was nothing to worry about.

Han Xiao crossed his arms, crossed his legs, and closed his eyes to rest.

At this time, a strange man's voice suddenly sounded beside him.

"Can I sit here?"

He opened his eyes and saw a man with golden skin standing beside him. He was carrying a bag and had a smile on his face. He was a Godora, but his skin color was very light. He did not seem to be a pureblood Godora.

Han Xiao's heart tightened, and he immediately raised his guard. At this point, he was innately wary of any hybrid Godoran.

"Who are you?"

"Haha, I seem to be too abrupt. Allow me to introduce myself." This Godora bowed elegantly and said in a proper tone, "My name is Ovenn. As you can see, I'm a Godora. However, don't worry, I'm not a pureblood with high standards. I'm just an ordinary Godora and Galactic Human hybrid. I'm sorry to disturb you, but I hope to be your companion on this short journey."

Everyone had a strange expression.

A stranger came out of nowhere and wanted to be friends with them. No matter how they thought about it, it was strange!

Could it be that someone's charm had attracted this guy?

Everyone looked at Fu Ding and then at Han Xiao. Their gazes shifted back and forth.

Han Xiao pointed to the side. "There are still empty seats there. If you just want to find a place to rest, please don't disturb us."

"No, no, no, please don't misunderstand me …" Ovenn suddenly sat down and squeezed Herlous in. He seemed to be determined to stay there. With a warm smile on his face, he said sincerely, "I'm also a traveler in Noriose. My companions are at the port, and I'm the only one who came to the surface. It's too lonely to be alone, and I love to make friends. There's a saying in my hometown — 'When you're out, you have to make friends openly. That's the way of a man.'"

"Hey, hey, hey, don't squeeze me. We haven't agreed to let you sit down!" Herlous was unhappy.

"Hmm? You guys are playing Wayne Cards?" Ovenn saw the cards on the table, and his eyes sparkled. He took out a stack of cards from his backpack, slapped it on the table, and said, "I'm an expert at Wayne Cards. I use the Radiance Domain Deck, and no one has ever beaten me. How about it? Do you dare to play a round with me?"

"Why are you acting so familiar with us? Who wants to play cards with you? "Herlous was speechless.

Ovenn laughed and said confidently, "Indeed, it's boring to just play cards. Let's make a bet. 50 Enas per round. Do you dare to play a round with me?"

"Oh, you want to challenge me?" Herlous was furious. He felt that his dignity as the 'Black Star God of Gamblers' was being challenged … although there were not many Black Star Mercenary members.

At the same time, Herlous secretly turned to look at Han Xiao.

Han Xiao made a hand gesture, indicating that he allowed it.

He had just checked on Ovenn. This Godora person was very weak, and his energy wave had only reached Grade C. He could kill him in one second, so he was not much of a threat.

He wanted to see who this Godora person was and what he had up his sleeve, so he allowed him to stay and observe him closely.

—
